api_list.name: Liquidation Data
api_list.description: Get the summary liquidation data for all coin. Data include total liquidation value, total liquidation amount, mean & median liquidation value.

optional_parameters.name: coin
optional_parameters.description: Need to specify coin name if type equal to detail

optional_parameters.name: type
optional_parameters.description: Choose type of data. If type equal to **detail**, it will show only 1 coin data. type need to be use with coin

api_list.name: Liquidation Report
api_list.description: Get the latest liquidation data from Binance, Bybit and OKX exchange. Data is limited to 1000 rows.

optional_parameters.name: coin
optional_parameters.description: Not required parameter. If put will show only that coin related data. For example **BTC**
